column3: Investigate and correct the witness false-positive where a global dispatch candidate is counted as active=0 but the exact-owner check returns 2 although the canonical task ledger already records the same task active. Reproduce the 2026-09-14T06:21:13Z and 07:15:55Z cases, plus the documented 2026-09-13T18:40:41Z queue-to-claim race. After inspecting mesh-task source semantics, make the witness reconcile an exact candidate against current canonical ledger/dispatch state after a refused check, and classify only proven transitions out of eligibility as benign while preserving FAIL for persistent contradictions, malformed state, and unreadable data. Add regression fixtures for both a concurrent transition and a preexisting active row missing from the witness audit/snapshot; verify the installed and source code paths, fixture suite, and live read-only run. Do not alter routing, DNS, firewall, VPN, or exit-node state.
